assertions.name: configured-real-duration
assertions.detail: The Task Server partition must last at least 600000 real milliseconds.

assertions.name: multiple-preclaimed-slots
assertions.detail: At least two already-claimed remote slots must execute through the outage.

assertions.name: useful-work-throughout-outage
assertions.detail: Every slot must record useful work through the configured partition.

assertions.name: no-unsafe-new-claim
assertions.detail: Transport uncertainty must not admit the waiting task.

assertions.name: authority-before-replay
assertions.detail: Every slot must reconcile its exact fence before replay completes.

assertions.name: results-and-terminal-delivered-once
assertions.detail: Events, artifacts, Result SHA, terminal, and completion must survive recovery without duplication.

assertions.name: outboxes-drained
assertions.detail: Every recovered Runner outbox must be fully acknowledged.

assertions.name: no-zombie-or-phantom-generation
assertions.detail: Recovered slots must close their one contained generation with no zombie replacement.
